schema.description: Single-photo moderation decision when the target photo ID is supplied in the URL path. Requires either action ('approve' | 'reject') or status ('APPROVED' | 'REJECTED').
Batch photo moderation payload requiring between 1 and 100 photo identifiers (in ids, photoIds, or nodeIds) and a moderation decision (action or status).

anyOf.description: Batch photo moderation payload requiring between 1 and 100 photo identifiers (in ids, photoIds, or nodeIds) and a moderation decision (action or status).
Single-photo moderation payload for the moderation queue endpoint. Requires a target photo identifier (id, nodeId, or photoId) and a moderation decision (action or status).

schema.description: First-run site setup and authenticated configuration payload. Requires either password (validated against ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH or ADMIN_PASSWORD during step-1 setup authentication), setupCompleted (for authenticated wizard completion), or full site initialization fields (non-placeholder baseUrl plus partner1Name & partner2Name or legacy brideName & groomName; unauthenticated first-run requests must also include password).
Guest self-service invitation lookup payload. Requires at least one of query (min 2 characters or valid email), name (min 2 characters), or email (valid email address).

get.description:
Scanner-safe read endpoint for signed guest claim confirmation/cancellation links.
Performs zero database mutations so email security link scanners cannot confirm or cancel gifts.

post.description: Explicit form-submission mutation endpoint for signed guest claim confirmation or cancellation.

schema.description: Gift contribution payload requiring itemId, a positive amount, and a contributor name (name or purchaserName, 1-100 characters).

post.description:
Adds multiple items to the registry in an atomic transaction.

**Response:**
*   **`201 Created`** - Returns the list of created items and count.

Adds a new item to the registry.

**Response:**
*   **`201 Created`** - Returns the newly created `RegistryItem` object.
    ```json
    {
      "id": "clxfa5z...",
      "name": "Stand Mixer",
      "description": "A powerful stand mixer for all our baking adventures.",
      "category": "Kitchen",
      "price": 299.99,
      "image": "/images/mixer.jpg",
      "vendorUrl": "https://example.com/mixer",
      "quantity": 1,
      "isGroupGift": false,
      "purchased": false,
      "purchaserName": null,
      "amountContributed": 0,
      "contributors": []
    }
    ```

Scrapes metadata in parallel for batches of up to 20 product URLs with a concurrency limit of 5.
Individual URL failures do not abort the overall batch.
The entire batch operation times out after 15 seconds.

Stripe webhook handler for registry contributions.
Cryptographically verifies signatures using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
Processes payment_intent.succeeded, charge.refunded, and charge.dispute.created idempotently.
